*Generated by the `mlkit-idea-browser` skill. **Metadata note:** this generator produces evidence-scored ideas, not community posts, so the task's "author / status / votes / tags" map to: **Author** = the skill pipeline; **Status** = verdict (Build / Prototype / Shelve); **Votes** = Opportunity score /10 (derived from the weighted rubric, not crowd votes); **Tags** = idea type + themes.

## 🔥 Highlighted — High-priority / trending this run

**Model Delivery Observability** — a status contract for the models ML Kit silently downloads.
This is the run's lead idea and the one worth acting on. It is "trending" in the only sense this pipeline measures: the **demand signal is convergent across six years** (the same feature request recurs in firebase-android-sdk #47 → #1656 → mlkit #315, #760, #829), and it rides a **statutory clock** — the EU DMA Art 6(7) decision (DMA.100220, 16 Jul 2026) forces Alphabet to open on-device-model access by **1 Aug 2027**. Its standout property: it reaches the **whole ~3B Google-Play-services fleet**, ~20–27× the ~3.7% that runs Gemini Nano — escaping the reach trap that caps most on-device GenAI ideas.
→ Full report: [`mlkit-idea-model-delivery-observability-2026-10-08.md`](./mlkit-idea-model-delivery-observability-2026-10-08.md)

## Per-idea detail

### 1. Model Delivery Observability — Opportunity 8/10 (Infrastructural) · **Prototype → Build**
- **Description:** Today ML Kit's unbundled models (Translation, Language ID, Segmentation, Face, Entity Extraction…) are downloaded by Play Services with no progress, no state enum, and no typed failure reason on Android — so delivery "fails silently." This proposes an observable status flow + typed reasons (`DEVICE_UNSUPPORTED`, `OFFLINE_NO_CACHE`, `WIFI_REQUIRED`…) + a stability SLO.
- **Metadata:** Author: skill pipeline · Status: Prototype → Build (composite 3.9) · Score: 8/10 · Tags: whole-fleet-reach, regulatory-clock, developer-voiced, trending.
- **Why it leads:** max platform privilege (only Play Services owns delivery), near-zero feasibility risk (no model; iOS ML Kit + Android GenAI already expose byte progress), whole-fleet reach, and a DMA deadline that de-risks durability.
- **Main risk:** self-absorption — Google may ship the minimum delivery-status surface as plain DMA compliance; the differentiated value is the typed-reason taxonomy + SLO.

### 2. On-device eval harness + token accounting — Opportunity 7/10 · Prototype
- **Description:** Developers currently can't tell whether their on-device AI feature regressed between releases. Apple shipped an Evaluations framework (WWDC26); ML Kit has a prose "evaluate prompt quality" page with no tooling behind it.
- **Metadata:** Author: skill pipeline · Status: Prototype · Score: 7/10 · Tags: apple-shipped-this, fast-to-build, gated-to-3.7%.
- **Why not #1:** reach is gated to the ~3.7% GenAI base, versus the winner's whole-fleet reach. Strong, fast-to-build runner-up.

### 3. Standalone on-device safety/moderation classifier — Opportunity 6/10 · Prototype
- **Description:** Play policy makes app developers liable for generated/user content; Bumble open-sourced its own classifier because no platform primitive exists. A tunable on-device classifier would fill it.
- **Metadata:** Author: skill pipeline · Status: Prototype · Score: 6/10 · Tags: regulatory-clock, liability, tunability-risk.
- **Why not #1:** one-size-fits-all moderation dies on contact with a real trust-and-safety team unless tunability is designed in — a larger product risk.

### 4. On-device neural TTS developer API — Opportunity 5/10 · Shelve (re-trigger)
- **Description:** True whitespace — Google has no modern on-device TTS API; Picovoice sells Orca; Apple added on-device speech generation.
- **Metadata:** Author: skill pipeline · Status: Shelve · Score: 5/10 · Tags: true-whitespace, feasibility-risk, needs-a-model.
- **Why shelved:** needs a model Google must source, deliver, and hold quality on — high feasibility/ownership cost versus the winner's near-zero. Re-trigger: a shippable on-device TTS model class at mid-tier quality.

### 5. Sub-8GB GenAI reach tiering — Opportunity 5/10 · Shelve (re-trigger)
- **Description:** Explicit quality tiers / small-model paths so a GenAI capability runs on the mid-tier fleet, not only the ~3.7% flagship base.
- **Metadata:** Author: skill pipeline · Status: Shelve · Score: 5/10 · Tags: reach, feasibility-is-the-game, unproven-quality.
- **Why shelved:** feasibility (what quality a small model achieves on mid-tier silicon) is the whole game and is unproven. Re-trigger: published benchmarks showing acceptable quality in a sub-8GB budget.
